searches.reason: Develop practical HSTU probes that distinguish dependence on recent intent from broad historical associations. Compare intact histories with recent-window truncation, old-prefix removal, and order shuffling, preserving left padding and reading the final nonpadding position. Measure paired rank changes on training-history next-item examples, stratify by history length, and calibrate against random perturbations. These sensitivity tests can identify which sequence information matters without claiming causal user intent or changing the host evaluator.

searches.reason: Translate redundant alternatives, compatibility failures, and insufficient evidence into distinct, auditable diagnostic signals. Explore conservative attribute extraction from available titles and descriptions, with explicit unknown states, and training-history evidence for substitutes versus complements. Validate extracted constraints manually on a small sample and report evidence coverage; do not infer fulfilled needs, compatibility, or dislike from missing information, and do not require pretrained weights or unavailable metadata.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostics substitute complement redundancy product compatibility title description attribute extraction uncertainty abstention evaluation 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Build a trustworthy bridge from qualitative feedback to actionable model diagnosis. Investigate a small feedback taxonomy separating choose-now appeal, mere relatedness, explicit mismatch, and insufficient evidence, then connect observed failures to paired score margins and HSTU component sensitivity within the single trained model. Use user-level uncertainty estimates and negative controls; treat the twenty users as exploratory evidence and retain the pinned macro validation HR@10 as the selection criterion.
